sources.snippet: This repository contains the code and resources for Promptriever, which demonstrates that retrieval models can be controlled with prompts on a per-instance basis, similar to language models. NOTICE: the MTEB version of Promptriever is broken in v1, please use the v2 branch which will become the main branch soon.
